body.x: AVING News conducted a mini interview withMayor Kwon Young-jin at the CES 2020, the world's largest technology exhibitionheld in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10.

Daegu Metropolitan City has supported 196ICT venture companies and SMEs in the area to enter the market for eightconsecutive years since 2013, with the cumulative contract amount of $22.4million as of 2019. Daegu Joint Pavilion, organized by Daegu Technopark MobileConvergence Center, had 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups.

Major programs include exhibitions,investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES reviewconferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to runjoint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilionhas been set up in CES 2020.
The world’s largest IT show CES shows thetrend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted byConsumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
Let’s watch the video of the interview withMajor Kwon. Below are the questions and answers with Mayor Kwon.
Q: I heard that Daegu has participated inCES every year since 2013 and that the companies are doing quite well. I wouldlike to ask how you feel about it.

A: Our Daegu and Gyeongbuk companies…Especially IT companies, they have great technology but they weren’t doing toowell in global marketing. They are in the world’s largest ICT exhibition now,proudly standing next to great companies. Seeing that they are receiving greatresults from many companies, the future of Daegu and Gyeongbuk is bright. Thisis what I think.
Q: There are many innovative technologyindustries led by Daegu. How do you plan to develop these exhibitions in thefuture?

A: First of all, to commercialize thetechnologies we have, and connect to the businesses, we should finish thecompany composition early. And perform business marketing in Korea first, andcome out here. That way, we can sign the contracts with the buyers we contactedin Korea... That way, we will really be able to help companies grow bysupporting them to come here. This is what we should strengthen.
